brief:
A mass wedding ceremony in Gaza united 250 couples in celebration, according to Al Jazeera English. The event took place as Israeli military operations continue across the territory, with organizers framing the gathering as an affirmation of life and commitment despite ongoing conflict.

The couples exchanged vows together in a coordinated ceremony, marking what participants described as new beginnings amid the strain of war on daily life in Gaza.
dek: The event brought 250 couples together to celebrate love and new beginnings despite Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza.
title: Gaza hosts mass wedding for 250 couples amid war
